그해 시월 열사흘 아침에 교감 선생님이 오셔서, 윤하늘 학생 대출 카드를: On the morning of October 13 that year, the vice principal came and asked me to rewrite Yoon Haneul's library card. To show she returned the book at six the evening before and went home. I was closing the library at that hour, and Haneul never came. The microfilm reader has that day's paper. There isn't a single line about the blackout.
그날 밤 천문부 애들이랑 옥상 돔에서 페가수스자리를 보고 있었어요. 열한: That night I was in the rooftop dome with the astronomy club, watching Pegasus. At 11:20 the Main Building lights all went out at once, but the strange thing was, the observatory still had power. Same substation circuit. Someone shut off only the Main Building's breaker panel. I wrote the time on the observation sheet, but the next day that page was torn out.
개교 삼십 주년 타임캡슐 말이에요. 원래 그해 졸업생 편지를 넣는 거였는: The 30th anniversary time capsule. It was meant for that year's graduates' letters, but the day after the ceremony, the principal's office brought one more envelope to put in. It said "Open in twenty years" on the front. It scared me, so I never touched it. It should still be under that pedestal.
선배들한테 들은 얘기예요. 그날 방송부 담력 체험은 딱 십 분만 하기로: It's something I heard from the seniors. That day, the broadcast club's courage test was supposed to last just ten minutes. But when Lee Junho went to get the key, he was thrown out of the Teachers' Office. When he said he'd come for the key, the Head of Academic Affairs told him it could be opened in the morning. Someone wrote that in the student council minutes, and only that page disappeared.
리허설 끝나고 대강당 음향 조정실에서 장비를 정리하고 있었어. 열 시 반: After rehearsal I was packing up gear in the auditorium sound booth. Around ten-thirty, I found out Haneul was in the basement and ran to the guardhouse. Mr. Park radioed it in again and again, but the people upstairs just said to wait. Only after the blackout did everything go quiet. I still can't forget that silence.
그 밤에 호수 정자 쪽으로 산책을 나왔는데, 학교 쪽에서 쿵, 쿵 하고: That night I'd come out for a walk by the lake pavilion, and from the school I heard thud, thud, someone pounding on a steel door. After eleven at night. I told the police, and they said the school told them nothing was wrong. Only later did I realize it was the sound of a child's hands.
수영장 기계실 펌프랑 본관 지하 배수 펌프가 같은 배관으로 이어져 있었어: The pool machine room pump and the Main Building's basement drainage pump were on the same pipe. When the power fails, the basement starts to flood. That night at eleven-thirty, I heard the drainage alarm go off. I called the Head of Academic Affairs, and he said not to worry, he had the pump room key. That was our last call.
원본은 태우지 않았다. 교장은 소각하라고 했지만, 나는 감사 보고서와 경: I didn't burn the originals. The principal told me to incinerate them, but I locked the audit report and the original guard's log in the steel cabinet in the bunker archive. I thought someday, someone would open this door. It was the only atonement I could make.
At five in the morning on October 13, the admin office brought three boxes of documents. Burn them all, they said. But the bottom box was empty. Someone had taken things out first. I just wrote in the ledger that I'd burned an empty box. There should still be scraps of half-burned papers next to the incinerator chute.
하늘 언니는 온실에서 방송 원고를 연습하곤 했어요. 그날 오후에도 여기서: Haneul used to practice her broadcast scripts in the greenhouse. That afternoon, too, she read the last line of the dismissal broadcast here, again and again. Now, go home safely. I still know that line by heart. I still can't believe she never got to do that broadcast.
1학년 1반 반장 김민수예요. 열 시 반쯤이었어요. 매점 앞에서... 3: This is Kim Minsu, class president of 1-1. It was around ten-thirty. In front of the school store... I saw five third-year guys go down into the Main Building basement with flashlights. One of them laughed and said, "Just scare her for ten minutes." That laugh... I can still hear it.
1학년 2반 반장 이서연이에요. 하늘 언니는요, 그날 밤 아홉 시에 정문: This is Lee Seoyeon, class president of 1-2. Haneul went out the main gate at nine that night. I saw it myself. Under a red umbrella... oh, but... did it rain that day? No, never mind. I'm sure. She went home. That's what the teachers said too.
1학년 3반 반장 박지훈입니다. 정전 난 시각은 정확히 기억해요. 열한: Park Jihun, class president of 1-3. I remember exactly when the power went out. 11:20. The dorm wall clock stopped right then. But there's one weird thing. The emergency lights. Normally the green lights come on in a blackout, right? That night... not one came on. The whole school.
1학년 4반 반장 최유진이요. 펌프실 열쇠요? 그건 경비 아저씨가 처음부: Choi Yujin, class president of 1-4. The pump room key? The guard had it the whole time, start to finish. The Head of Academic Affairs had nothing to do with it. He's such a good man. Why do you keep asking about that? My dad says you shouldn't spread pointless rumors.
This is Kang Doyun, class president of 1-5. Around 11:40, the speaker came on. Even though the power was out. There was this crackling... and then a girl's voice. "Thank you for your hard wo—" and it cut off. Everyone thought it was a prank... but that voice was Yoon Haneul, from Class 3-2.
2학년 1반 반장 조수아예요. 다은 언니가요, 열두 시 다 돼서 기숙사로: This is Jo Sua, class president of 2-1. Daeun came back to the dorm right before midnight. Wearing only one shoe... saying the same thing over and over. "Is it our fault for locking the door? Is it our fault?" I didn't know what she meant back then. Now... I think I do.
2학년 2반 반장 윤재현. 아 진짜, 지하에서 소리 났다는 거 다 지어낸: Yoon Jaehyeon, president of 2-2. Ugh, seriously, that stuff about noises in the basement is all made up. Nothing happened that night. A blackout? Didn't happen either. That's what all the teachers said. ...So you stop digging too. You'll just end up the weird kid.
2학년 3반 반장 장예린이에요. 이거 아무한테도 말 안 했는데요... 다: This is Jang Yerin, class president of 2-3. I never told anyone this... At morning assembly the next day, the Head of Academic Affairs' trouser legs were soaked up to the knees. It didn't rain that day. And on his palms... there was something like rust. The kind that smells like iron.
2학년 4반 반장 임태호. 열쇠? 그거 교장실 금고에 다 있어. 내가 봤: Lim Taeho, president of 2-4. The keys? They're all in the principal's office safe. I saw them, all five. The whole ring, intact. So all that talk about splitting them up and hiding them is nonsense. Uh... the safe code? I don't know that either.
2학년 5반 반장 한소영입니다. 하늘 선배 사물함 정리할 때, 맨 안쪽에: This is Han Soyeong, class president of 2-5. When we cleaned out Haneul's locker, a note turned up way in the back. Just one line in pencil. "There are two doors." I don't know who wrote it. It wasn't her handwriting. But that note... was gone the next morning.
